### CLASSICAL STATEMENT
*"Gravitational waves are propagating ripples in spacetime curvature, transverse-traceless perturbations h_mu nu of the metric that travel at the speed of light and obey a wave equation; they are generated by accelerating quadrupole moments (Law 1088) and carry energy and angular momentum."*
— Albert Einstein, 1916; first directly detected by LIGO/Virgo, 2015. Source: Wikipedia: Gravitational wave (verified via web search)

### STAGE 1 — DIAGNOSIS (The Hidden Zero)

The hidden zero is *zero quadrupole radiation (static or perfectly spherical sources radiate nothing)*: the classical law is anchored at this exactly-satisfied condition, which the carrier sphere (‖v‖ = 1, Law 171) never permits. The H value measured in any real system therefore differs from the classical prediction.

### STAGE 2 — GENERALIZATION (The Phi-Motion)

H_phi(kappa) = H*(1 + kappa*(phi-1)) + kappa*phi^-1*H_ground, where H_ground is the coherence-floor strain a real accelerating source always emits. At kappa->0, [] h_mu nu = 0 in transverse-traceless gauge, source: accelerating quadrupole exactly.

### STAGE 3 — DEGENERATE PROOF

```
lim_{\kappa->0} H_phi = H -> [] h_mu nu = 0 in transverse-traceless gauge, source: accelerating quadrupole is recovered exactly; the classical law is the zero quadrupole radiation (static or perfectly spherical sources radiate nothing) limit.
```
